blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings rose from 56 in June to 62 in September (+10.7%), and it took 12.2% of the city’s 188 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings rose from 17 in June to 18 in September (+5.9%), and it took 8.2% of the city’s 184 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Albion for detached houses in July, August (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, August, September (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July (a buyers’ best bet).

items.t: Maple Ridge real estate market stats
Sell my house in Maple Ridge

Fee-simple lots are the default form: Houses sit under the compact urban zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, with RS-1 (Single Detached Residential), s. 605 — minimum lot area 668.0 m², minimum lot width 18.0 m, minimum lot depth 27.0 m, maximum lot coverage 40% — as the standard urban house zone in the bylaw's schedule. The Area Plan's residential designations include Low Density Residential (single detached at an urban standard, with lot sizes at 2,000 m² in the designation text read), Ground-Oriented Residential, Cluster Residential and Townhouse, plus an Albion Village Commercial node — plan designations, stated only as the plan text states them, never as a for-sale lot inventory.
Bare-land strata: none verified: The four strata townhome complexes below are built strata on built lots, not bare-land strata, and must never be presented as lot stock.
Classification conflict — Rydge, cross-reference only, counted NOWHERE in Albion: A buyer searching only one name will mix the two areas' stock.

Assemblies / development sites — documented as plans, never as inventory: Council adopted updates to the Albion Area Plan on October 28, 2025 — responding to regional-partner feedback, enhancing walking and cycling connections, supporting the growth of local commercial nodes, and introducing buffers where urban development meets farmland; the plan seeks a balance between new residential development and protection of environmentally sensitive areas across a range of housing styles. Check a lot's current designation before valuing it as a plain house lot; a designation is not an approval and no development site is listed as inventory here.
Tenure records — never lot stock, stated with the reason: Park/co-op official confirmation of rules, rents and counts: UNCONFIRMED.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Albion

items.t: Municipality: City of Maple Ridge, BC.
Boundaries: the City publishes no boundary for the MLS sub-area as such: UNVERIFIED as an official boundary. The Albion Area Plan's Schedule 1 map is the closest official boundary document.

Nearby areas: Cottonwood and East Central to the west along Lougheed Highway, Thornhill to the northeast, Kanaka Creek / North Maple Ridge ground to the north, and the Fraser River along the south edge.

Main roads and commute: Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) along the south side; 240 Street is the main north–south road; 102 Avenue and 104 Avenue run east–west through the residential area; the Golden Ears Bridge west of the city connects Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows to Langley and Surrey. Commute times in minutes: UNVERIFIED.

Transit: Haney Place Exchange is in the Town Centre to the west (routes include the R3, 701, 733, 741, 743, 744, 745, 746, 748, 749 and 791; the R3 runs Coquitlam Central Station to Haney Place). Which of those routes run on Albion streets was not re-verified route by route: UNVERIFIED. Port Haney Station (22300 River Road) and Maple Meadows Station (20010 Dunn Avenue) serve the west side of the city; West Coast Express trains run weekdays between Waterfront and Mission City.

Schools physically in the area (Ministry-listed names and addresses only): Albion Elementary, 10031 240 Street; c'usqunela Elementary, 24093 104 Avenue; Kanaka Creek Elementary, 11120 234a Street (at the area's west edge); Samuel Robertson Technical Secondary, 10445 245 Street. SD42 has no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12).

Kanaka Creek Regional Park (Metro Vancouver) runs along the area's west side, with the Canyon Trail to Cliff Falls and the Bell-Irving Hatchery. No library branch sits in Albion — Maple Ridge Public Library is at 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road in the Town Centre. Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, is the community hospital with 24/7 emergency care; the Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 121 – 11900 Haney Place, open 7 days a week, 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Albion

items.t: OCP citation CONTESTED — flagged, resolved nowhere; Albion Area Plan settled: The settled part: the Albion Area Plan is Chapter 10.2 of the OCP, and Council adopted updates to it on October 28, 2025 (walking/cycling connections, local commercial nodes, farmland buffers). Quote the OCP bylaw number only from a current City document for the specific property.

Floodplain (south edge): the south edge of Albion sits along the Fraser River and Kanaka Creek — the flood construction level is 6.7 m geodetic (including freeboard), a covenant on title identifies construction in the floodplain, no habitable floor space may be located below the flood construction level on affected lots, and Zoning Bylaw s. 402.8(h) prohibits rental accommodation (suites) on floodplain properties. Which Albion lots are affected is per-parcel: UNVERIFIED.

ALR block — full form (South Albion ground): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval, and ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Information Bulletin 09, s. 6; Strata Property Act, s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act, s. 21(1)). Residence caps: one principal residence per parcel, maximum 500 m²; a secondary suite only inside the principal residence; one additional residence capped at 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less and 186 m² on parcels over 40 ha. Farm class (BC Assessment) in full three-tier form: $2,500 of gross farm income at 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area over 4 ha above that; $10,000 under 0.8 ha — applications by October 31. A flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR and none is asserted here.

BC strata block — applies in full to any strata lot here (including the four townhome complexes' resales): Form B (SPA s. 59), provided within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢/page; depreciation reports every five years for stratas with five or more lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Reg 7.01, May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid age bylaw. None of Albion's four complexes carries a verified 55+ bylaw — Albion verifies zero 55+ stock, and Maple Ridge has ZERO verified 55+ strata townhouses. For The Warwick, first establish whether the unit is a developer sale or a resale, because the document route (REDMA/GST vs Form B) differs.

Presales (REDMA) — Warwick units only: REDMA s. 21 gives a 7-day rescission period from the later of signing or acknowledging the disclosure statement, with deposits in trust under s. 18 — the frame for any unit still on a developer contract at The Warwick.

Planned transit — price on today's service: TransLink's Langley–Haney Place BRT is in detailed planning — 22 km between Willowbrook and Haney Place with peak service every 10 minutes; designs, costs and timelines are not yet determined.

All four townhome complexes stand within a few blocks of one corner. Albion Station, Ridgemont, Spencer Brook Estates and The Warwick all cluster at 104 Avenue / 240 Street, beside the Albion Commercial Corner and c'usqunela Elementary — complex-level comparables here are effectively a single-intersection market, and none of it is lot stock.
Spencer Brook Estates (EPS763, 40 homes, built 2015) was verified by the 55-plus run — while proving it was NOT 55+ — and never appeared in the condos run's three-complex townhome list.

The farmland buffer is new policy with a date. The Oct 28, 2025 Area Plan update introduced buffers where urban development meets farmland — houses closest to the South Albion ALR edge now sit beside a stated buffer policy, not just a field. Whether that edge discounts or complicates those houses is Jared's Section 8 question, UNVERIFIED here.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Albion than in June?
faq.a: In Albion, listings of houses rose from 56 in June to 62 in September (+10.7%); condos and townhomes rose from 17 in June to 18 in September (+5.9%).

faq.q: How big is Albion compared with the rest of Maple Ridge?
faq.a: In September 2026, Albion held 15.1% of the 410 houses listed in Maple Ridge and 6.3% of the 286 condos and townhomes listed in Maple Ridge.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Albion from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 23 houses and 15 condos and townhomes sold in Albion over those 4 months.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Albion?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Albion?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Can I buy a bare building lot in Albion?
faq.a: There is no lot product to buy — no named bare-land subdivision offering, bare-land strata plan or presale lot offering exists here. What trades is built fee-simple house lots, strata townhomes at the 104/240 corner, and South Albion farm parcels.

faq.q: Are Albion Station, Ridgemont, Spencer Brook and The Warwick land I can buy as lots?
faq.a: A purchase there is a strata-lot purchase with fees, bylaws and a Form B; The Warwick additionally needs a per-unit developer-sale vs resale determination before GST/REDMA treatment is relied on.
Contested: the developer says Albion, the board listings say Thornhill MR. Price a 248 Street listing against the sub-area its listing actually sits in.

faq.q: What did the October 2025 Area Plan update change for a lot?
faq.a: Council adopted the update Oct 28, 2025: enhanced walking/cycling connections, support for local commercial nodes, and buffers where urban development meets farmland, consolidating land-use policies for provincial housing legislation. Check a growth-edge lot's current designation before valuing it as a plain house lot.

faq.q: Is this South Albion parcel in the ALR?
faq.a: Only a parcel-level check settles it — the research places ALR parcels in South Albion in words only, with no split figure. Check the ALC maps and title before pricing subdivision, a second dwelling or farm-class value into the parcel; on ALR ground, subdivision needs ALC approval and residences cannot be stratified.
